description: Header file defining the URLSecurityManager class and related allowlist class for managing URL security policies, including default credentials and Kerberos delegation policies.

classes.name: URLSecurityManager
classes.description: Abstract class managing URL security policies such as allowlists for credentials and delegation.

classes.name: URLSecurityManagerAllowlist
classes.description: Concrete class implementing URLSecurityManager with allowlist functionality.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a platform-dependent instance of URLSecurityManager.

methods.name: CanUseDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Checks if default credentials can be used for a given URL.

methods.name: CanDelegate
methods.description: Checks if Kerberos delegation is allowed for a given URL.

methods.name: SetDefaultAllowlist
methods.description: Sets the allowlist for default credentials.

methods.name: SetDelegateAllowlist
methods.description: Sets the allowlist for delegated Kerberos tickets.
